verdict.rationale: Scribe returns transcripts as JSON with segments, speaker or channel labels, and timing. Batch jobs can write transcripts straight into the user's own S3 storage next to the input files, and reusable vocabulary assets can be listed via the API, so the core outputs are portable in an open format. However, nothing documents an account-wide export of all data, retention or deletion on leaving, or offboarding. missing for 10: documented bulk or account-level export of all data, explicit data retention/deletion or offboarding docs, independent corroboration of portability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
